sources.title: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B Instruct - API Pricing & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct is a 7B parameter instruction-tuned language model optimized for code-related tasks such as code generation, reasoning, and bug fixing. Based on the Qwen2.5 architecture, it incorporates enhancements like RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, and GQA attention with support for up to 128K tokens using YaRN-based extrapolation.
